tbesh_html:
A woman living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Ki.15.2; married to Amaziah (H0558);
mother of: Uzziah (H5818)
§ Jecoliah or Jecholiah = "Jehovah is able"
wife of king Amaziah of Judah and mother of king Uzziah (Azariah)

strongs_1890.derivation: and יְכׇלְיָהוּ; or (2 Chronicles 26:3) יְכִילְיָה; from H3201 (יָכֹל) and H3050 (יָהּ); Jah will enable;
